messages:
dana: Heads-up — onboarding redwood-alpha to the catalog. Need quick checks on weights location + tokenizer before we schedule a canary.
leo: Where are the weights currently staged? public or private bucket?
maria: They're in GCS (staging): gs://rw-models/staging/redwood-alpha/v0.3.1/
leo: thx. can you confirm checksum and model.tar layout?
maria: checksum: sha256:8a3f4c9b7e... (pushed by infra pipeline)
maria: tree looks like:
```
model.tar
├── model.bin
├── config.json
└── tokenizer.model
```
sam: quick note — tokenizer is sentencepiece bpe, we saw a tokenization mismatch in local eval: special token <|user|> got split. Can we confirm special_tokens in config.json?
maria: config.json snippet:
```
{
  "max_sequence_length": 4096,
  "tokenizer": "sentencepiece",
  "special_tokens": {"bos": "<|bos|>", "eos": "<|eos|>", "user": "<|user|>"}
}
```
kevin: that should be fine but our tokenizer wrapper expects "<|user|>" to be mapped to one id. sentencepiece can split it if model was trained with different normalization. I can run token ids check.
kevin: ran `rw-token-check --model gs://rw-models/staging/redwood-alpha/v0.3.1` output:
```
WARN: special token '<|user|>' tokenized as ['<', '|', 'user', '|', '>'] (3 pieces)
OK: vocab size 50288
```
dana: oof. That explains the context boundary issues in the smoke tests. Options: add custom post-tokenize merge, or swap to the trained tokenizer file (maybe tokenizer.json) — do we have that?
maria: I only see tokenizer.model in the tarball.
leo: simplest short-term fix: in serving config set special_token_ids to explicit ids (if we know them) or enable pre-token merge. Long-term, re-export tokenizer with user token as single piece.
kevin: I can try a post-tokenize merge rule in the tokenizer wrapper. Will test on 100 prompts and post results.
dana: also running config validation now: `rw-validate-config --model-path gs://rw-models/staging/redwood-alpha/v0.3.1 --cfg configs/redwood-alpha-serving.yaml` returned errors:
```
ERROR: max_sequence_length (4096) > runtime supported max (2048)
ERROR: kv_cache_enabled true but model checkpoint missing kv-compatible metadata
```
sam: so we need to 1) cap max_seq_len or enable runtime with longer seq, 2) fix kv cache metadata or disable cache for canary.
leo: For canary plan I suggest: pin model to redwood-alpha:v0.3.1, force max_sequence_length=2048 in serving config, disable kv cache, and provide fallback variant redwood-alpha-quant:v0.3.1 for lower mem hosts.
dana: agreed. Also region plan: start 1% canary in us-east1 only. If stable for 24h then expand to eu-west1. Can we gate the rollout on smoke evals (latency < 120ms p50, failure < 0.5%)?
kevin: yes I can add smoke eval hook to the rollout config.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout config created: model=redwood-alpha v0.3.1, canary=1%, region=us-east1, fallback=redwood-alpha-quant v0.3.1, env-overrides: {max_sequence_length:2048, kv_cache_enabled:false}
maria: I'll upload a new tarball with tokenizer.json later today so we can remove the post-token-merge hack.
sam: can someone please ping datapriv/security to confirm staging bucket ACLs? We need private-read for dedicated customers.
dana: @maria can you add datapriv to the thread? (or file a ticket)
maria: filed DP ticket #DP-442: ACL review for gs://rw-models/staging/redwood-alpha. pinged in ticket.
leo: code-review ping @kevin for the serving wrapper change (small merge rule + unit tests)
kevin: on it, will open PR in ~30m. Marking as WIP.
dana: final checklist before scheduling canary:
- [ ] tokenizer single-token fix or wrapper merge (kevin)
- [ ] upload tokenizer.json (maria)
- [ ] serving config override (leo)
- [ ] validate ACLs (maria / datapriv)
- [ ] add smoke eval gating (kevin)
- [ ] schedule canary (platform/SRE)

sam: SRE / eng-sre — can you reserve a 1% canary slot in us-east1 tomorrow 10:00 PT? Need to coordinate maintenance windows.
kevin: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-serving/pull/278 (WIP) — tests failing on one tokenizer edge-case, debugging.
deploy-bot: Canary started (canary-id: c-8242) — redwood-alpha:v0.3.1 in us-east1 (1%)
dana: thanks all. please drop updates here. :eyes:
